Colonist | Full-Stack Product Dev | Remote (Eastern Europe / SEA) | Full-time

Colonist (https://colonist.io/) is a multiplayer strategy game with millions of players. We're a small team and you'll own features end-to-end, from backend game logic to polished UI.

You'll work on evolving our game architecture, ensuring cleaner code boundaries and better scalability.

Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, CSS, PostgreSQL/SQL. We lean heavily on AI tooling for development.

More details and apply: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/colonist/109d62c4-52f3-4980-9c49-d3...
